[Neuroglancer](https://github.com/google/neuroglancer) is a browser-based
viewer for large volumetric datasets. This guide is a quick visual reference
for finding your way around the interface and navigating in both the 2D
image panels and the 3D view. Each animation shows the action; the note
beside it gives the key combination.

::: {.callout-note}
The exact toolbar and panels vary a little between deployments (for example
[Spelunker](https://spelunker.cave-explorer.org/), the MICrONS viewer). The
controls and shortcuts shown here work the same way across all of them.
:::

## The Neuroglancer interface

When you open a Neuroglancer link you will see one or more **panels** showing
the data, a row of **layer tabs** across the top, a **coordinate readout**, and
a **toolbar** in the top-right corner (see [Toolbar &
settings](#toolbar-settings) below).

### Layer tabs

The tabs across the top of the viewer are the **layers** — the separate pieces
of data in the scene (for example an EM image layer and a segmentation layer).

![](media/select_layer_tab.png){width=520 fig-alt="A layer tab showing the tooltip: click to hide, control+click to show side panel, drag to move, shift+drag to copy." fig-align="center"}

* **Click** a tab to turn that layer on or off.
* {{< kbd Ctrl-Click >}} a tab to open its side panel.
* **Drag** a tab to reorder it, or {{< kbd Shift-Drag >}} to copy it.

### Coordinates

The coordinate readout shows the current position (in nanometers). Click it to
paste in a coordinate, or click the copy icon to copy the current location.

![](media/coordinates_icon_0.png){width=420 fig-alt="The coordinate readout showing x, y, and z positions with a copy button." fig-align="center"}

### Panel layout

Switch between layouts with the {{< kbd space >}} key, or by clicking the
box-in-box icon in the upper corner of any panel. You can choose a 1-panel,
2-panel, or 4-panel view.

![](media/select_layout_boxes.png){width=140 fig-alt="The box-in-box layout toggle icons." fig-align="center"}

::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-sm-4}
![](media/select_layout_2panel.png){fig-alt="Two-panel layout." fig-align="center"}

**2 panel** — a 2D slice beside the 3D view.
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-sm-4}
![](media/select_layout_4panel.png){fig-alt="Four-panel layout." fig-align="center"}

**4 panel** — three 2D slices plus the 3D view.
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-sm-4}
![](media/select_layout_3d.png){fig-alt="Single 3D panel layout." fig-align="center"}

**3D only** — just the 3D view.
:::
:::

The **xy** plane is in the plane of imaging and has the highest resolution; the
default 2-panel view is **xy-3d**.

## 3D navigation

These actions work in the **3D panel** (the right panel by default).

::: {.grid .mb-4}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-7}
![](media/text_3d_left_click_drag.gif){fig-alt="Left click and drag rotates the 3D view around the centered point." fig-align="center"}
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-5}
**Rotate** — {{< kbd Left-Click >}} + drag.
:::
:::

::: {.grid .mb-4}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-7}
![](media/text_3d_shift_click_pan.gif){fig-alt="Shift plus left click and drag pans the 3D view." fig-align="center"}
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-5}
**Pan** — {{< kbd Shift >}} + {{< kbd Left-Click >}} + drag.
:::
:::

::: {.grid .mb-4}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-7}
![](media/text_3d_scroll_zoom.gif){fig-alt="Hovering over the 3D panel and Ctrl plus scroll zooms." fig-align="center"}
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-5}
**Zoom** — {{< kbd Ctrl-Scroll >}}.
:::
:::

::: {.grid .mb-4}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-7}
![](media/text_3d_right_click_jump.gif){fig-alt="Right clicking an object centers it in every panel." fig-align="center"}
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-5}
**Center in every panel** — {{< kbd win=Right-Click mac="Two-finger Click" >}}.
:::
:::

## 2D navigation

These actions work in the **2D image panels** (the left panel by default).

::: {.grid .mb-4}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-7}
![](media/text_2d_left_click_pan.gif){fig-alt="Click and drag pans the 2D EM image." fig-align="center"}
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-5}
**Pan** — {{< kbd Left-Click >}} + drag.
:::
:::

::: {.grid .mb-4}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-7}
![](media/text_2d_scroll_zoom_1.gif){fig-alt="Hovering over the image panel and Ctrl plus scroll zooms." fig-align="center"}
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-5}
**Zoom** — {{< kbd Ctrl-Scroll >}}.
:::
:::

::: {.grid .mb-4}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-7}
![](media/text_2d_select_deselect.gif){fig-alt="Double clicking a cell selects it; double clicking again deselects it." fig-align="center"}
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-5}
**Select / deselect a cell** — {{< kbd Double-Click >}}.
:::
:::

::: {.grid .mb-4}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-7}
![](media/text_2d_right_click_jump.gif){fig-alt="Right clicking centers the clicked point in every panel." fig-align="center"}
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-5}
**Center in every panel** — {{< kbd win=Right-Click mac="Two-finger Click" >}}.
:::
:::

## Controlling perspective and overlays

These toggles change how the scene is displayed.

::: {.grid .mb-4}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-7}
![](media/text_2d_3d_slice_scroll.gif){fig-alt="Scrolling over the image panel moves between slices of the volume." fig-align="center"}
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-5}
**Add section overlay** — {{< kbd S >}} toggles to add the current section(s) from the 2D views to 3D.


**Move through the section slices** — mouse wheel, or {{< kbd , >}} / {{< kbd . >}}.
:::
:::

::: {.grid .mb-4}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-7}
![](media/text_2d_3d_space_panel_layout.gif){fig-alt="Pressing space cycles through the panel layouts." fig-align="center"}
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-5}
**Cycle panel layouts** — {{< kbd space >}}.
:::
:::

::: {.grid .mb-4}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-7}
![](media/text_3d_ortho_projection.gif){fig-alt="Pressing O toggles between perspective and orthographic projection; a scale bar appears in the orthographic view." fig-align="center"}
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-5}
**Toggle projection style** — {{< kbd O >}}. Switches between perspective and
orthographic views. Orthographic equalizes depth, so a scale bar appears.
:::
:::

## Visualization


![](media/text_3d_recolor_segments.gif){fig-alt="Pressing L assigns a fresh random color to every visible segment." fig-align="center"}

**Recolor all segments** — {{< kbd L >}}. Assigns a fresh random color to every
segment, which can help when neighboring cells overlap.


## Toolbar & settings

The toolbar in the upper-right corner opens the side panels and tools:

![](media/icons_full_tab.png){fig-alt="The Neuroglancer top-right toolbar with Share, Layers, Selection, Controls, JSON, Help, and Settings icons." fig-align="center"}

| Icon | Opens | What it does |
|:--:|:--|:--|
| ![](media/icons_share.png){width=50 fig-alt="Share"} | **Share** | Creates a shareable, **shortened link** that captures your current view, visible segments, and annotations. |
| ![](media/icons_palette.png){width=30 fig-alt="Wrench"} | **Palette** | Shows the tool palette list (includes default Shader Controls). |
| ![](media/icons_layers.png){width=30 fig-alt="Layers"} | **Layers** | Shows the list of data layers (images, segmentations, annotations). |
| ![](media/icons_details.png){width=30 fig-alt="Bullet List"} | **Details** | Shows details submenu for whatever you have selected. |
| ![](media/icons_menu.png){width=30 fig-alt="Sliders"} | **Controls** | Opens layer side panel, controls for the active layer (color, opacity, shaders). |
| ![](media/icons_json.png){width=30 fig-alt="Curly brackets"} | **JSON** | Opens the raw JSON state — the full, editable definition of the scene. |
| ![](media/icons_screenshot.png){width=30 fig-alt="Camera"} | **Screenshot** | Opens the built in screenshot tool. |
| ![](media/icons_clipboard.png){width=30 fig-alt="Clipboard"} | **Copy URL** | Copy the full URL to the clipboard.|
| ![](media/icons_shortcuts.png){width=30 fig-alt="Question Mark"} | **Shortcuts** | Lists every keyboard and mouse binding. |
| ![](media/icons_settings.png){width=30 fig-alt="Gear"} | **Settings** | Global settings (axis lines, scale bar, memory limits, backgrounds). |

: {.bordered tbl-colwidths="[22,18,60]"}

The **Settings** (gear) panel controls display options for the whole viewer:

![](media/controls_side_menu.png){width=360 fig-alt="The Neuroglancer Settings side panel with options such as Show axis lines and Show scale bar." fig-align="center"}

## Keyboard shortcuts

| Key | Action |
|:--:|:--|
| {{< kbd Left-Click >}} + drag | Rotate (3D) / pan (2D) |
| {{< kbd Shift >}} + {{< kbd Left-Click >}} + drag | Pan (3D) |
| {{< kbd win=Right-Click mac="Two-finger Click" >}} | Center the clicked point in every panel |
| {{< kbd Ctrl-Scroll >}} | Zoom |
| Mouse wheel | Move between slices |
| {{< kbd , >}} / {{< kbd . >}} | Move between slices |
| {{< kbd Space >}} | Cycle panel layouts |
| {{< kbd A >}} | Show / hide the colored axis lines |
| {{< kbd S >}} | Show / hide the 2D slice in the 3D view |
| {{< kbd L >}} | Recolor all segments globally |
| {{< kbd O >}} | Switch between 3D orthographic and projection views |
| {{< kbd Z >}} | Snap to the nearest axis (also undoes a sheared 2D view) |

: {.bordered tbl-colwidths="[35,65]"}

::: {.callout-tip}
Pressing {{< kbd Z >}} is handy if you have "sheared" the 2D view with
{{< kbd Shift >}} + {{< kbd Left-Click >}} + drag and want to return to the
original orientation.
:::
